name: Beijing eGOVA Co,. Ltd
summary: Beijing eGOVA Co,. Ltd develops and sells of professional smart city application software in China. The company offers unified network management, urban management, the lifeline of the city, government service hotline, urban operations, rule of law government, social governance, city parking, and municipal facilities solutions. It is also involved in computer and underground pipeline detection services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
